  title: "Compare two models"
format: html
editor: source
execute:
  echo: false
---
  
  ## get the two models
  
  
```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library("nmfspalette")
library(patchwork)

run_SSMSE_dir <- file.path("")
default <- file.path(run_SSMSE_dir, "default")

res_sigma <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_SigmaR.rda"))
summary_sigma <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_summary_SigmaR.rda"))

res_r0 <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_R0.rda"))
summary_r0 <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_summary_R0.rda"))

res_sr <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_sigmaR_r0.rda"))
summary_sr <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_summary_sigmaR_r0.rda"))

res <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_multirun_cpuefix_clean.rda"))
summary <- readRDS(file = file.path("results_summary_multirun_cpuefix_clean.rda"))

```

```{r}

plot_sigma <- summary_sigma$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_sigmaR_EM_2062", "default_sigmaR_OM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, F_5)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = model_run))+ theme(legend.position = "none")


plot_r0 <- summary_r0$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_r0_EM_2062", "default_r0_OM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, F_5)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = model_run)) 

  

library(patchwork)

plot_sigma+plot_r0

test_cv <- summary_sigma$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_sigmaR_EM_2062", "default_sigmaR_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary_r0$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_r0_EM_2062", "default_r0_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare

test_cv <- summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_random_10", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_random_10", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare



test_cv <- summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 11, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 11, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare
```


```{r}

mean_f_5_model_runs_sigma <- summary_sigma$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3") %>%
  group_by(model_run) %>%
  reframe(mean_F_5 = mean(F_5))

mean_f_5_model_runs_r0 <- summary_r0$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3") %>%
  group_by(model_run) %>%
  reframe(mean_F_5 = mean(F_5))

waldo::compare(mean_f_5_model_runs_sigma, mean_f_5_model_runs_r0)

sigma <- summary_sigma$ts %>%
  mutate(type = "sigma")
r0 <- summary_r0$ts %>%
  mutate(type = "r0")
sigma_r0 <- summary_sr$ts %>%
  mutate(type = "both")
og <- summary$ts %>%
  mutate(type = "original")

all <- rbind(sigma, r0, sigma_r0, og)

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -4)) %>%
  filter(F_5 > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_run, y = F_5, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge())

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -2)) %>%
  filter(F_5 > 0) %>%
  mutate(F_5_ratio = F_5/0.2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_run, y = F_5_ratio, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario)

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -2)) %>%
  filter(F_5 > 0, model_run != "se", !str_detect(model_run, "OM")) %>%
  mutate(F_5_ratio = F_5/0.2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = F_5_ratio, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + ggtitle("just the EMs F_5 ratios") + 
  facet_wrap(~scenario) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.75,1.25))

all %>%
  filter("red_tide_random_10")

```


```{r}

red_tide_years <- all %>%
  filter(F_5 > 0) %>%
  pull(year)

sigma <- summary_sigma$dq %>%
  mutate(type = "sigma")
r0 <- summary_r0$dq %>%
  mutate(type = "r0")
sigma_r0 <- summary_sr$dq %>%
  mutate(type = "both")
og <- summary$dq %>%
  mutate(type = "original")

all <- rbind(sigma, r0, sigma_r0, og)


mean_value.F<- all %>%
  filter(str_detect(model_run, "OM")) %>%
  reframe(mean_value = median(Value.F, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_value)

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -2)) %>%
  filter(year %in% red_tide_years) %>%
  mutate(F_ratio = Value.F/mean_value.F) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_run, y = F_ratio, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge())


mean_value.recr<- all %>%
  filter(str_detect(model_run, "OM")) %>%
  reframe(mean_value = median(Value.Recr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_value)

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -2)) %>%
  mutate(recruit_ratio = Value.Recr/mean_value.recr) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_run, y = recruit_ratio, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed")

all %>%
  mutate(model_run = str_sub(model_run, -2)) %>%
  filter(model_run != "se", !str_detect(model_run, "OM")) %>%
  mutate(recruit_ratio = Value.Recr/mean_value.recr) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = recruit_ratio, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + ggtitle("just the EMs recruitment ratios") + ylim(c(0,5))

```
